A Recursive Algorithm to Render Signed Distance Fields
Mar 6, 2026Signed Distance Fields (SDFs), also known as implicit surfaces, are a mathematical way to define 3D objects. If polygons and rasterization are like imperative programming, then SDFs are (literally) the functional paradigm for graphics.
